test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Given below are six sentences of a paragraph.

Sentence A is the beginning whereas sentence F is the last sentence of the para. The middle four sentences are jumbled up. Select the option that gives their correct order forming a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. When I studied Engineering thirty-five years back, I was the only girl in the course.

B. People often ask me how I managed.

C. I could only see boys and more boys everywhere.

D. But when I look back I feel it was not very difficult.

E. Having a girl in the class was unusual for the boys, and initially I was the target for a lot of teasing.

F. But over a period of time they became my best friends.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph starts with an introduction to the situation: "**When I studied Engineering thirty-five years back, I was the only girl in the course."**
 
• The next logical sequence is **"I could only see boys and more boys everywhere**."
 
• This is followed by the explanation: **"But when I look back I feel it was not very difficult.**"
 
• Finally the transformation over time is described: "**Having a girl in the class was unusual for the boys, and initially I was the target for a lot of teasing."**
 
• This leads naturally to the conclusion that "**But over a period of time they became my best friends."**
 
• Therefore, the correct order of the sentences is **CBDE**
